note: All organizations below are real, active NGOs, identified through public information (web search). This is not the same as ImpactSetu doing its own 12A/80G/CSR-1 due-diligence verification. That verification layer is a planned platform feature, not something we've built yet. Jivika Foundation is included because the platform's builder has first-hand knowledge of it. ngos.desc: One of India's larger nutrition NGOs, running mid-day meal and child nutrition programs (Kiran/Annapurna) reaching over a million children.
National child rights organization with an active Telangana chapter, working on child health, nutrition, and protection.
Runs the Telangana Nutrition Mission, reportedly serving nutrition supplements to over 20 lakh children daily across the state.
Large-scale mid-day meal program for school children; headquartered in Bengaluru, operating across multiple states.
Focuses on malnutrition treatment through fortified food supplements for children and mothers.
Bengaluru-based NGO working on empowerment and livelihood support for people with disabilities.
Mumbai-based NGO running the Aahar program focused on maternal and child nutrition in urban slum communities.
International hunger-focused NGO with an active India program (Project Ankur) treating acute child malnutrition.
Supports anganwadi (ICDS) nutrition programs and child welfare initiatives in Maharashtra.
Works on health and nutrition among tribal communities in Gadchiroli, one of Maharashtra's most underserved districts.
